about.text: A sour-milk cheese invented in 1813 by a farmer named Kaul in Groß-Gerau, Hesse, and sold at the Mainz weekly market. Salt and ripening cultures are mixed into lean quark, which is shaped into small loaves after a few hours and ripened for about a day.

sources.text: The German articles on Mainzer Käse and sour-milk cheese.
